title: File:Jar (China), 1736–95 (CH 18315569).jpg
desc: Ginger jar. Blue and white. Ovoid, the blue underglaze decoration in four bands, the widest through the body consisting of floral scrolls and chrysanthemum blossoms. Lotus petal border at the base. Chien Lung.
